help.search.en_us:
## Recipes and uses

| Goal | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Obtain an item | Hover it in your inventory and press R |
| Find what an ingredient makes | Hover it and press U |
| Browse one mod | Type @create or @farmersdelight in the item search |

Recipe and use keys belong to the item browser, not this handbook. Change them in its settings.

## Existing help

Create machines show a Ponder prompt in their tooltips. Hold the displayed key for the demonstration. [Controls](help.controls.md) explains how to change bindings.

Polymorph lets you choose between conflicting crafting results.
help.search.zh_cn:
## 配方与用途

| 目标 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 获取物品 | 在物品栏中指向物品，按 R |
| 查看材料用途 | 在物品栏中指向物品，按 U |
| 按模组筛选 | 在物品搜索栏输入 @create 或 @farmersdelight |

配方与用途按键属于物品浏览器，不是本手册。在浏览器设置中修改。

## 已有帮助

机械动力机器的提示中有思索入口。按住提示中的按键观看演示。[操作与按键](help.controls.md)介绍如何修改按键。

Polymorph 用于选择存在冲突的合成结果。

help.controls.en_us:
## Change a binding

1. Open Options, then Controls, then Key Binds.
2. Use Controlling to search for an action or mod.
3. Select its binding and press the replacement key. Check conflicts before returning to play.

## Handbook access

Click Handbook in your inventory, or press F9 by default. Change Open Astropunk Handbook in Key Binds. Your current handbook key: <KeyBind id="key.astropunk_handbook_access.open" />.

## Current controls

These labels follow your current bindings.

| Action | Your key |
| --- | --- |
| Inventory | <KeyBind id="key.inventory" /> |
| Jump | <KeyBind id="key.jump" /> |
| Sneak | <KeyBind id="key.sneak" /> |
| Sprint | <KeyBind id="key.sprint" /> |
| World map | <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_open_map" /> |
| Waypoints | <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_waypoints_key" /> |
| Skills | <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> |
| Carry On | <KeyBind id="key.carry.desc" /> |
| Contextual guide | <KeyBind id="key.guideme.guide" /> |

The contextual guide key requires an item associated with a handbook page.

## Item browser defaults

| Action while hovering an inventory item | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Recipes | R |
| Uses | U |

Change these inside the item browser settings. Create's Ponder prompt shows its own key.

## Readability

Open Video Settings and increase the interface scale for larger text. This also enlarges other interfaces. The handbook uses a bounded page width so paragraphs stay short.
help.controls.zh_cn:
## 修改按键

1. 打开选项、控制，再打开按键绑定。
2. 用 Controlling 搜索操作或模组。
3. 点击当前按键，再按新按键。返回游戏前检查冲突。

## 打开手册

点击物品栏中的手册按钮，或按默认的 F9。在按键绑定中修改打开 Astropunk 手册。当前手册按键：<KeyBind id="key.astropunk_handbook_access.open" />。

## 当前按键

这里显示你当前设置中的按键。

| 操作 | 当前按键 |
| --- | --- |
| 物品栏 | <KeyBind id="key.inventory" /> |
| 跳跃 | <KeyBind id="key.jump" /> |
| 潜行 | <KeyBind id="key.sneak" /> |
| 疾跑 | <KeyBind id="key.sprint" /> |
| 世界地图 | <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_open_map" /> |
| 路标 | <KeyBind id="gui.xaero_waypoints_key" /> |
| 技能 | <KeyBind id="key.puffish_skills.open" /> |
| 搬运 | <KeyBind id="key.carry.desc" /> |
| 物品关联指南 | <KeyBind id="key.guideme.guide" /> |

关联指南按键需要该物品已关联手册页面。

## 物品浏览器默认按键

| 指向物品栏中的物品时 | 默认按键 |
| --- | --- |
| 查看配方 | R |
| 查看用途 | U |

在物品浏览器设置中修改这些按键。机械动力的思索提示会显示自身按键。

## 阅读设置

在视频设置中调大界面缩放，可以放大文字，也会放大其他界面。手册采用有限页面宽度，避免段落过长。
